faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick, honest answers about booking and visits. Anything else? Message us on WhatsApp and we'll reply fast.
faq.q1: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a1: Choose the service, offer, or doctor you need on our website and tap the book button — it opens WhatsApp with a message already prepared for you. Our team replies quickly to confirm your appointment time.
faq.a2: Yes, we accept medical insurance. Message us on WhatsApp with your insurance provider so our team can confirm coverage for your treatment.
faq.a3: Yes, we offer a free consultation. You can ask about your condition and the recommended treatment plan before deciding to proceed.
faq.a4: We're open every day. Send us a message on WhatsApp for the most up-to-date opening hours and to find a time that suits you.
faq.a5: We are located in Hafr Al-Batin, Saudi Arabia. Use the Get Directions button on our contact page to open our location in Google Maps.
